# RamaCare Polyclinic, Jumeirah 1, Dubai

DHA-licensed outpatient polyclinic in Jumeirah 1, Dubai, close to Al Satwa. Operated by Rama Care Polyclinic LLC.

## Core Information
- **Name**: RamaCare Polyclinic (legal name: Rama Care Polyclinic LLC)
- **Address**: Ground Floor, Jumeirah Terrace Building, 12 Al Dhiyafah Road, Jumeirah 1, Dubai, UAE (PO Box 393558)
- **Google Maps**: https://maps.google.com/?cid=4290863257518002596
- **Hours**: Every day, 10:00 to 22:00. Walk-ins welcome.
- **DHA facility licence**: 2036418
- **Languages spoken**: English, Arabic, Hindi, Malayalam, Tagalog
- **Insurance**: Reimbursement basis. Patients pay at the clinic and receive an itemised invoice and medical report to claim from their insurer.
- **Parking**: Free and paid parking near the building.
- **Emergencies**: Not an emergency service. Call 998 or go to a hospital emergency department.


## Departments
- **General medicine (GP)**: consultations, infections, minor injuries and wound stitching, check-ups, blood pressure, diabetes, cholesterol and thyroid care. https://ramacarepolyclinic.ae/services/general-physician-dubai/
- **Dentistry**: check-ups, scaling and polishing, fillings, root canal treatment, crowns and bridges, extractions, whitening, veneers. https://ramacarepolyclinic.ae/services/dental-dubai/
- **Physiotherapy**: assessment and rehabilitation for back, neck, shoulder and knee pain, sports injuries and post-surgery recovery. https://ramacarepolyclinic.ae/services/physiotherapy-dubai/
- **Dermatology and aesthetics**: DHA-licensed dermatologist; acne, pigmentation, hair loss; Botox and fillers, laser hair removal, HydraFacial, HIFU, RF microneedling. https://ramacarepolyclinic.ae/services/aesthetic-dermatology-dubai/
- **Ayurveda**: consultation with a DHA-licensed Ayurveda physician; Abhyanga, Shirodhara and Panchakarma planned after consultation. https://ramacarepolyclinic.ae/services/ayurveda-dubai/
